versions.changelog: Rewrote frontmatter description to concise 200–500 character format for improved agent-trigger clarity.

Initial release. Drafts a Codex / NACMCF 7-principle HACCP plan or FSMA Preventive Controls food-safety plan from a product, process flow, and hazard inventory, with a hazard-analysis matrix, CCP / PC determination via decision tree, critical limits with validation references, monitoring and corrective-action procedures, verification activities, and a recordkeeping log for PCQI / HACCP-team review.
